objective: Substantially reduce research-to-usable-proposal latency and quota at unchanged required source quality and discovery coverage.
registration_note: This is a finite design menu, not an activation, an assurance of completion or a fixed case answer key. Executing orchestrator binds legitimate cases, exact tools, per-job limits and models prospectively.

methods.title: Two substantive stages rather than three
methods.control: Fresh researcher, fresh critic, then a separate final revision.
methods.treatment: Fresh researcher, then a fresh critic that checks and authors the complete final; preserve real critique dispositions.
methods.unit: A coherent research-and-proposal module; integrated topology contrasts also exercise the complete brief.
methods.measure: Final correctness and supported coverage; handoff loss; total latency, occupancy and output. Equal aggregate budget; record stage allocation.
methods.guard: Do not import old I-07 answers or reuse its timing as a contemporaneous control. Fewer stages are not automatically better.

methods.title: Coherent multi-question batching
methods.control: Comparable related questions handled in separate bounded candidate research assignments.
methods.treatment: One coherent assignment researches the same questions together and reuses their shared context.
methods.unit: Two or three related questions with cross-cutting conditions; not unrelated full product domains.
methods.measure: Repeated reading/writing and cold-start cost, same supported question coverage, cross-question confusion.
methods.guard: Keep a per-question disposition and shared-condition map. Count all control jobs and all treatment work; no gratuitously wasteful baseline.

methods.title: Progressive, repository-guided evidence retrieval
methods.control: Reasonable native search/read workflow, without forced whole-repository scans.
methods.treatment: Use available file/symbol/section navigation, read focused evidence, and expand to governing definitions and call paths when needed.
methods.unit: Actual component behavior at a pinned version, including a condition outside the first matching passage.
methods.measure: Source-reading time and delivered context versus correct mechanism interpretation, missed conditions and versions.
methods.guard: Do not replace source inspection with an architecture summary or hide relevant sources from control. Navigation is an index, not evidence of truth.

methods.title: Exact evidence reuse across stages
methods.control: Each stage independently obtains its requested source bytes through ordinary access.
methods.treatment: Same-case source cache resolves exact requested URLs/commits and extraction versions; critics retain independent query freedom.
methods.unit: Repeated use of public documentation and code across research and criticism.
methods.measure: Cold fetch plus subsequent cost, cache hits, source freshness and critique quality.
methods.guard: Do not give treatment evaluator summaries or preselected answers. Content-address raw bytes, never share sibling answers; report cold and warm economics separately.

methods.title: Incremental research and already-covered reuse
methods.control: A legitimate full refresh after a predefined plan/source change.
methods.treatment: Reuse exact supported prior findings whose declared dependencies remain unchanged; research the changed dependency closure.
methods.unit: A no-op change plus a substantive source/API/plan change, with obligations at the dependency boundary.
methods.measure: Refresh time, missed invalidations, false already-covered classifications, cold-seed cost and amortized cost.
methods.guard: Both arms receive the same legitimate prior state. Similar wording is not equivalence; unresolved dependencies cannot silently be accepted as covered.

methods.title: Executed checks with an independent oracle
methods.control: Source-grounded checking using ordinary reasoning and existing general tools, without the specific oracle recipe.
methods.treatment: Candidate selects bounded trusted operations, independent derivations, differential or metamorphic checks, then binds the result to its report.
methods.unit: A consequential numerical, serialization, ordering or identity claim with correct and incorrect controls.
methods.measure: Correct defect detection, false rejection, executed-result/report agreement, verification time and usage.
methods.guard: Executing the claimed formula is not an oracle. A round trip between mutually wrong functions is insufficient. Check applicability, units, versions, and test discrimination.

methods.title: Critical-dependency-first verification with protected coverage
methods.control: Reasonable full-scope critic allocating attention in normal document order.
methods.treatment: Verify assumptions that could invalidate the selected recommendation first, while reserving an explicit lower-risk and breadth check.
methods.unit: A selected design with essential dependencies and independently useful optional discoveries.
methods.measure: Critical-error detection and time to useful correction; full required coverage and missed lower-ranked findings.
methods.guard: No top-k deletion of remaining leads. Unchecked optional evidence remains visible; a required promise cannot be relabeled optional to pass.

methods.title: Amendment-first repair and final-change checking
methods.control: Critic feedback followed by a normal coherent final rewrite.
methods.treatment: Amend supported finding records locally; check every changed consequential claim and affected dependency before rendering the final.
methods.unit: A draft containing supported material, local errors, uncertainty and interacting changes.
methods.measure: Lost valid findings, new final errors, citation/result drift, repeated output and finalization latency.
methods.guard: Required corrections can change or reject upstream claims. Exact retention of false content earns no credit; do not add an unbudgeted fourth full review.

methods.title: Parallel complementary critics at equal total work budget
methods.control: One critic reviews the declared bounded scope.
methods.treatment: Two same-family critics cover complementary evidence/implementation risks in parallel, followed by explicit reconciliation.
methods.unit: One bounded module whose two review responsibilities are meaningful and overlap on a small critical seam.
methods.measure: Critical-path time, aggregate occupied time, unique correct defects, contradictions and reconciliation cost.
methods.guard: Total candidate budget includes both critics and reconciliation. Majority agreement is not source truth; nested tasks consume the family concurrency allocation.

methods.title: Evidence-first criticism to reduce agreement bias
methods.control: Critic reads the proposal before checking the evidence.
methods.treatment: Critic first derives a short answer to the same bounded question from legitimate sources, then receives the candidate claim and reconciles.
methods.unit: Supported claims, plausible false claims and justified uncertainty on the same source task.
methods.measure: False endorsement, false rejection, discovery of counterevidence and additional cost.
methods.guard: Candidate critic is still flash-level. Do not leak evaluator-derived answers or turn the first phase into unbounded duplicate research.

methods.title: Early release/API and unit/domain binding
methods.control: Normal source-grounded research that resolves versions and units as it proceeds.
methods.treatment: Bind the chosen component release, API/default behavior, coordinate/unit/type domains and applicability before dependent derivations.
methods.unit: A component recommendation with an older issue, a fix, a current release and a nontrivial applicability condition.
methods.measure: Avoided false incompatibilities and rework, correct affected-version boundaries, total reading and writing.
methods.guard: A released fix is not proof all platforms are safe. Do not treat missing units as absent calibration or a comment as proof of every code path.

methods.title: Protected breadth, assumptions and cross-component analogies
methods.control: Competent brief-only open discovery without a diversity-specific recipe.
methods.treatment: Explore different mechanism families and challenge product assumptions, including analogous components outside direct competitors.
methods.unit: An open research question based on a thin plan/brief, not an assigned answer-bearing source list.
methods.measure: Distinct useful supported opportunities, avoided risks, breadth, redundant leads and time to decision-ready findings.
methods.guard: A fixed source count is not breadth. Preserve negative discoveries and uncertainty; no evaluator answer list or premium subject-matter hints.

methods.title: Implementation and issue-to-regression investigation
methods.control: Ordinary documentation plus relevant issue/repository reading.
methods.treatment: Trace an implementation branch and a real issue through fix, regression test and applicable release; stop when the bounded decision is supported.
methods.unit: A discovered component failure or improvement with potential planning implications.
methods.measure: Useful new mechanisms, false defect generalizations, history-reading cost and actionable test proposals.
methods.guard: An open issue is a lead, not consensus. A merged change is not automatically in the chosen release. Running one extracted function has a limited scope.

methods.title: Decision-focused single-source delivery
methods.control: One competent narrative research proposal with its normal source references.
methods.treatment: Maintain one authoritative semantic finding set; render a concise decision view plus complete evidence, conditions and optional-lead views mechanically.
methods.unit: A substantial output with decisions, alternatives, source conditions, validation proposals and open questions.
methods.measure: Authoring/reading time, meaning preservation, downstream usability and evidence lookup failures.
methods.guard: Shortening by omission is failure. The host may render and assign identities but cannot write scientific conclusions; do not require four manually synchronized catalogs.

methods.title: Parallel research scouts with bounded synthesis
methods.control: One candidate investigates the full bounded component question.
methods.treatment: Two same-family scouts investigate complementary mechanism families concurrently, then one bounded synthesis reconciles the union.
methods.unit: A question with independent source families and a real overlap/interaction to resolve.
methods.measure: Latency, aggregate cost, supported discovery coverage, duplication and synthesis loss.
methods.guard: No unlimited scout multiplication. Same total candidate-work ceiling; multi-account experimentation must not masquerade as a single-account product win.

methods.title: One broad discovery pass shared across related plan topics
methods.control: Two or three related sandbox plan topics each perform their normal independent discovery/comparison.
methods.treatment: One flash-authored shared discovery inventory feeds topic-specific comparisons; independent topic obligations remain explicit.
methods.unit: A small multi-topic project bundle sharing a component or failure mechanism.
methods.measure: Whole-bundle completion time, duplicate acquisition, unique topic coverage and reuse invalidation.
methods.guard: Include discovery/synthesis costs and prevent shared inventory bias from erasing topic-specific unknowns. Do not mix this task-level sharing with cross-arm answer leakage.
